question: Which CET bids are due within 30 days?

CET Bids Due Through Nov 7, 2026

Seven CET opportunities fall due between today (Oct 8, 2026) and Nov 7, 2026. Three of them close today, and one closes tomorrow (CET opportunity radar). None of the six COMMBUYS listings in the New England public bids feed are due before 2027.

  • Confirm the River Road pump station owner and bid documents before Oct 15, 2026, and assign it to Horton's CT team.
  • Staff the WRA Union Station generator bid and the NEVI installer reply as one crew and estimating plan. Start the Cambridge EV prequalification and DBE check now.
  • Pull current listings by hand from COMMBUYS and CTsource for the Oct 8 to Nov 7, 2026 window. This closes the coverage gaps above.
